maria: Heads up — canary for saffron13b (4-bit PTQ, new kernel) is showing entropy drop and short-loop repeats on the conv evals. Noticed high % of outputs ending in repeated phrase. Attaching a couple quick examples and metrics.

maria: Example prompt -> output (from canary run):
```
PROMPT: "Write a short apology email for a missed deadline."
OUTPUT: We apologize for the delay. We apologize for the delay. We apologize for the delay. Please accept our apologies.
```

sam: Ugh. Can you paste the raw tokens or logits snippet? Also which quant profile exactly?

maria: profile: saffron-4bit-v2 (layerwise PTQ, round-to-even), seed=42. Token slice and entropy numbers:
```
token_seq: [345, 87, 345, 87, 345, 87]
step_entropy (avg): 1.2 bits (canary) vs 4.5 bits (baseline fp16)
```

akshay: Hmm — that pattern smells like kv-cache or attention kernel mismatch after fallback to the new int8/4bit matmul. Did the runtime do a kernel fallback? Check logs for "fused_attn_fallback" and "kvcache_rewind". Repro command I used: `./infra/canary_run --model saffron13b --quant saffron-4bit-v2 --seed 42 --stream`

maria: Logs show a `fused_attn_fallback` around step 8 and then a `kvcache_clear` event. Pasting small excerpt: `2026-03-19T14:02:11Z [serve] fused_attn_fallback->kernel=mm_sm32_fallback; kvcache_rewind=1`

jessica: I pulled eval data: embedding cosine drift on our convo set is 0.23 (canary) vs 0.05 (baseline). Also top-5 next-token entropy collapsed for ~12% of prompts. Likely per-layer activation quantization scale mismatch.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy saffron13b:saffron-4bit-v2 -> succeeded on canary pool (nodes: c3-10-2).

maria: Rolled the canary back to saffron13b:fp16 for now on that pool and paused autoscaling. Will keep canary traffic limited until triage. Tagging @akshay @sam to investigate kernel/quant path. :eyes:

akshay: I'll run `python tools/quant_debug.py --model saffron13b --profile saffron-4bit-v2 --gpu gpu-2 --dump-acts` to capture per-layer histograms and compare to fp16 baseline. Also will run tokenizer sanity: saw two rare Unicode chars being split differently which could bias the first tokens.

sam: If you can reproduce locally, let's push a hotfix: revert kernel selector to the previous kernel and re-run the quant calibration with `calib_mode=per_channel` to see if entropy recovers. If confirmed, schedule a canary redeploy to 10% and add gate on "step_entropy_avg >= 2.5 bits".

jessica: I'll add automated checks to the Redwood Console eval suite: add per-step entropy plot and a short-prompt-repeat test (n=200) to the gate. Also create an alert if embedding drift > 0.12 on convo-eval.

maria: Thanks. I've filed INC-4521 with logs and sample outputs and linked this thread. Will update ticket after quant_debug run. :thumbsup:
